description: This file contains helper functions for retrieving logs from Kubernetes objects, specifically pods and pod lists, within the kubectl CLI tool. It manages log retrieval for various pod configurations and handles options like container selection and multiple pod scenarios.

methods.name: allPodLogsForObject
methods.description: Retrieves logs for all containers of a given Kubernetes object, supporting multiple pods and containers.

methods.name: logsForObject
methods.description: Retrieves logs for a specific Kubernetes object, with options for container selection and handling multiple pods.

methods.name: logsForObjectWithClient
methods.description: Core function that fetches logs for a Kubernetes object, handling different object types like Pod, PodList, and others, with support for multiple containers and pods.
